annotations.text:
This is the shell that actually mounts.
There is no Toolbar component in src/components/ and Preview.tsx is imported by nothing — a test asserts SplitView does not contain it. TabBar/, .split-divider and .pane-title are dead CSS too.
So: 38px drag strip, 220px TOC, one editor pane, 36px bottom tab bar. Theme and view mode are tweak chips above this artboard.

The source editor is set in a PROPORTIONAL font, and that is faithful, not a mistake in this mockup.
--editor-font-family defaults to -apple-system and .cm-content inherits it, so markdown source renders in the UI sans unless the user switches the Editor > Font preset to mono. Look at the pipe table on lines 23-26: the columns cannot align. Every other editor on the market sets source in mono by default.

Dark theme + the full Milkdown type ramp.
Worth checking here: the CodeMirror syntax palette is the unmodified @codemirror/language default (#708 purple, #a11 red, #161 green). It does not swap for dark mode, so source view on #0f1115 is the weakest contrast in the app.

TOC active state is the hardcoded literal rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1) with no dark override — it keeps the light accent on the dark surface.
Item height is implicit (6px padding + a 13px line), never declared.

No icon library is installed. Every glyph is text: + × x ▸ ▾ • * ↑↓←→, plus emoji in the settings nav.
Three different close characters are in use at three sizes. This is the single cheapest thing to fix and it moves the whole app.

Three directions, deliberately far apart — pick an axis, not a shade.
These are wireframes: grey bars stand in for text, one accent each signals the colour stance. Nothing here is pixel-accurate yet; the point is to choose before I build one out into the main window.

The settings surface, which the other four boards do not show.
Export is the 6th of 10 pages and holds exactly two settings. The board is clickable: Export and Integrations are drawn from source, the other eight say so.
Integrations is the only panel built to the design system — strong + .settings-row-description + .toggle-switch. The other eight use bare h4/p and a native checkbox, so identical rows come out 57px and 119px tall in the same dialog.
